CREATE TABLE t_merge_batch_dynamic (k UInt64, value Dynamic) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k SETTINGS merge_use_batch_sorting_queue = 1, enable_vertical_merge_algorithm = 0, min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0
